option.EquipmentRerollValueTargets.descr:
Single piece: 0 ignores an effect; 1–15 sets its minimum tier. Set at least one target. An effect the piece lacks cannot be created by value reroll and stops the task. A tier is an effect value tier (1–15), unrelated to equipment grade (T10 gear); T10 conversion rolls effects at tier 11.
![Tier value table](resource/announcement/images/EquipmentRerollValueTier.en_us.png)
option.EquipmentRerollValueTargets.label: Single piece minimum tiers
Sum of one effect's tiers across four pieces: **enter N and the task rerolls until the total is at least N** (0 = skip this effect; 1–60; stops early if materials run out).
Example: **Elemental Damage** with one roll on each piece — entering 34 gives ≈80.2%. Each effect has its own percentages, so look them up in the table; enter a larger number for more.
A tier is an effect value tier (1–15), unrelated to equipment grade (T10 gear); T10 conversion rolls effects at tier 11.
Value reroll only raises existing slots; a target above the maximum the current rolls can reach stops the task with a hint.
![Tier value table](resource/announcement/images/EquipmentRerollValueTier.en_us.png)

task.LuckyBoxOpening.doc:
After entering the inventory, this task walks the 5 categories under the Consumables tab: click Use All (top right) to select every usable item in that category, then click Use (bottom right) once it lights up, confirm in the dialog and claim the reward; categories with nothing usable are skipped.

- Recruitment: items related to recruiting NIKKEs
- Equipment: items for obtaining and enhancing equipment
- Collection: items for obtaining and managing collectibles and treasure items
- Upgrading: funding items for levelling up NIKKEs
- Skills: items for enhancing NIKKE skills

All and Others are not processed. Lock any item you do not want to use in-game first.
